description: Ask Clara Carros to source & quote a specific car to import (from German/EU auctions). Only call when the user wants an import quote, provides the wanted model plus their own name and phone or email, AND agrees to be contacted — pass consent=true only then. Submitting shares the provided contact details per Clara Carros' privacy policy.

consent.description: Set true ONLY if the user explicitly agreed to share their contact details and be contacted
